ABOUT THE PROGRAM

What Is ASIP?

ASIP (AtriBotix Student Innovation Program) empowers students to turn technical knowledge into practical projects through hands-on learning in Robotics, AI, IoT, and Coding.

It provides a platform for students to showcase their innovations, build technical confidence, and demonstrate their skills through verified student profiles.

From learning to innovation.
Build skills. Create projects.
Showcase achievements.

What Makes ASIP Valuable?

Practical Learning

Apply classroom knowledge through hands-on technology projects.

Verified Profiles

Showcase student projects and achievements through ASIP profiles.

Student Innovation

Encourage creativity, problem-solving, and independent thinking.

Project Discovery

Help schools, buyers, and organizations discover student-built projects.
